Jul 16, 2026 - Overall Project Daily Summary

Today, Optimism significantly enhanced protocol security and stability through critical bug fixes and Docker image hardening, while also advancing Superchain interoperability with a new super-aggregation feature for Kona SP1. Extensive documentation improvements were also a major focus, alongside the resolution of a key `op-proposer` issue.

## ✅ Completed Work
### Enhanced Protocol Security and Stability
- Hardened Docker images for `op-challenger`, `op-rbuilder`, and `rollup-boost` with a Wolfi base ([#21792](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21792)).
- Fixed known CVEs in Go toolchain and Rust dependencies ([#21854](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21854)).
- Addressed a journal discard issue in `op-revm` for non-deposit transaction errors ([#21723](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21723)).

### Superchain Interoperability and Kona SP1 Development
- Implemented the super-aggregation program for Kona SP1, enabling validation of aggregation inputs and recursive verification of proofs ([#21698](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21698)).
- Updated SP1 to v6.3.1 ([#21852](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21852)).
- Refined `op-proposer` to filter dispute games before loading metadata, improving efficiency and correctness ([#21780](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21780)).
- Implemented a CI check to verify the use of patched precompiles in Kona ([#18416](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18416)).

### Documentation and Developer Experience Improvements
- Added Diataxis tags across all documentation sections for better categorization ([#21830](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21830)).
- Split DA-footprint and fee-tuning guides ([#21821](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21821)).
- Added navigation validator and redirect lint guardrails ([#21843](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21843)).
- Added a canonical-home content guide ([#21841](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21841)), an `op-reth` CLI explanation page ([#21840](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21840)), and a span batches how-to page ([#21836](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21836)).
- Documented four OP Mainnet governance tasks related to signer rotations as `EXECUTED` with on-chain transaction links ([#1503](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1503)).

### Infrastructure and Tooling Refinements
- Removed prematurely merged `OPCMUpgradeV800` and `OPCMMigrateV800` templates and their tests ([#1501](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1501)).
- Updated `op-proposer`'s proposal source selection to use root format instead of interop mode ([#21710](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21710)).
- Swapped `DepositTx` construction and `Transaction-method` helpers in `op-node` as part of `opgeth-decoupling` ([#20269](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20269)).
